_how_to_edit: Each weekly night is one {...} block. It becomes one ticket on the site and one name in the moving strip under the top of the page. To switch a night off, change "active": true to "active": false. 'stub' is the short word printed big on the ticket (THU, FRI, SAT and so on). 'tone' picks the ticket colour: navy, cream, crimson, rose or olive. 'scratch' is optional: the deals listed inside it sit behind a scratch-off panel. 'marqueeExtras' adds more names to the moving strip. Write [Owner to fill in: ...] for anything you do not know yet. Save the file and the website updates.
